item.title: CISA Admin Leaked AWS GovCloud Keys on GitHub
item.description:
📝 Another file exposed in their public GitHub repository — “AWS-Workspace-Firefox-Passwords. ” The Private CISA GitHub repo exposed dozens of plaintext credentials for important CISA GovCloud resources. The GitHub account that included the Private CISA repo was taken offline shortly after both KrebsOnSecurity and Seralys notified CISA about the exposure.
🔗 Read more: https://krebsonsecurity.com/2026/05/cisa-admin-leaked-aws-govcloud-keys-on-github/
